title: Settings pane polish: keep the block heading visible when scrolled; align relay role rows in columns

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the ui in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-015357-ca10 for S251 (discovered from S251):

Keep the block heading visible when the settings pane scrolls
This is unchanged since the last round and I re-checked it. With a full matrix scrolled to the end at 80x24, the `slicer config` heading is above the window. Its orphan `check_command  go test ./...` row then reads like ork's `check_command` (scratch renders/scratch-matrix-80x24.txt:4-6; `internal/tui/settings.go:373-376`).
